title: CC's chart and verdict helpers ask CodeMother over the bus
intention: CC's chart and verdict helpers ask CodeMother's chart verb over the bus, one request per stage, instead of importing her stage machines.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_cc_proofs_reach_no_other_device.py tooth test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device reds on cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py (seven codemother imports) and cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py (one), beside cairn/devices/cc/scripts/cross.py (ticket 5e11fadd63b3).
traces_to: RULE 1; outline 9.3.4, 9.6 and Q#81; the cc proof's tooth test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device.
how: Make chart_ticket.py and verdict_ticket.py functions taking bus and learn, with __main__ blocks; each stage is reach('codemother').request(sender='CC', to='codemother', verb='chart', body={stage, op, input}); a refusal exits 1 with her reason. Red-first proof drives them with a recording bus.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py and cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py import nothing under cairn.devices

driven with a recording bus and a spec, chart_ticket sends orient floor, then a write for each of the seven stages in order, each a request to codemother verb chart sender CC, each write's packet carrying the previous stage's berth as its ref
driven with a recording bus, verdict_ticket sends one chart request, stage verdict op write, its packet carrying the chain's validate ref and the spec's verdicts
a refusal reply makes either helper exit 1 with CodeMother's reason and send nothing after it

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py: def chart(spec, *, bus=None, learn=None) -> int and a __main__ block; ask(stage, op, input) sends one chart request and returns the body's packet or berth, raising SystemExit(1) with the reason on accepted False; learn defaults to the skills.chart.live learn subprocess.
D2: cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py: def verdict(spec, *, bus=None, learn=None, chain=None) -> int the same way, one chart request stage verdict op write.

D3: the proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_the_chart_helpers_ask_codemother_over_the_bus.py, red-first, PROVES 1-4; it loads both helpers by path, drives them with a recording bus that answers each request, and an AST scan for clause 1; the house runner.

measured.saw: test_no_cc_file_imports_another_device FAIL naming chart_ticket.py:20-58 and verdict_ticket.py:9
